analyzed_description: Discussion on Bitcoin's recent price drop and the sustainability of the post-election rally, featuring insights from Example Ventures CEO Jane Doe.
key_takeaways: Bitcoin has dropped to around $94,400, moving away from the $100,000 milestone.
Jane Doe discusses the four seasons of Bitcoin and the potential for a double bubble.
Institutional interest in Bitcoin is expected to grow, especially with a crypto-friendly SEC.

topics.title: Bitcoin Price Movement
topics.summary: Bitcoin slid 2% to around $94,400, moving further from the $100,000 milestone. Ether and Solana also saw declines of 4.25% and 4.2%, respectively.

topics.title: Institutional Interest in Bitcoin
